details.name: Mejores amigas. Mismo enemigo. Misma venganza.

ads.copy: Ella y Leah lo dejaron todo por amor, pero sus esposos las traicionan de la peor manera. Mientras Ella arde entre las llamas, Charles elige salvar el gato de su ex. Noah también les da la espalda. Tras años de dolor, las dos mejores amigas toman la misma decisión: ¡divorciarse de los hermanos Harper!

details.name: Cast aside as worthless trash by his own family, a young genius returns a decade later, defying the heavens to single-handedly wage war against the world.

ads.copy: Bella's arranged marriage becomes a nightmare when she catches her fiancé cheating. Seeking revenge, she sleeps with a stranger, unwittingly bedding her fiancé's powerful mafia boss brother, Damian Gotti. Forced back into the Gotti family, Bella faces dangerous secrets and forbidden desires. Damian relentlessly pursues her under his brother's nose. Eventually, Damian exposes his brother's crimes,

After World War III, I became a scavenger in a chaotic world, surviving by trading salvaged junk for supplies—while being bullied by classmates who would steal what I'd gathered. By chance, I discovered alien technology and rescued three beautiful women who became my wives. Now, I aim to use these assets to become the King of the Wasteland!
